src='''def transform(grid):
    # Recolor cells to the right of a consecutive pair of marker cells,
    # stopping immediately before the next marker in that row.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        marker=next((v for v in row if v not in (0,)), None)
        # The examples use a single background color and marker color; identify marker
        # as the non-background value occurring sparsely.
        from collections import Counter
        bg=Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        marks=[i for i,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
        if len(marks)>=3 and marks[1]==marks[0]+1:
            for c in range(marks[1]+1,marks[2]): out[r][c]=3
        # dense random marker rows encode successive horizontal segments
        elif len(marks)>=2:
            for a,b in zip(marks,marks[1:]):
                for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
            # final marker launches only when there is an existing segment pattern
            if len(marks)>2:
                for c in range(marks[-1]+1,len(row)): out[r][c]=3
    return out
'''

    # stopping immediately before the next marker in that row.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]

        marker=next((v for v in row if v not in (0,)), None)
        # The examples use a single background color and marker color; identify marker

        from collections import Counter
        bg=Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        marks=[i for i,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
        if len(marks)>=3 and marks[1]==marks[0]+1:
            for c in range(marks[1]+1,marks[2]): out[r][c]=3
        # dense random marker rows encode successive horizontal segments
        elif len(marks)>=2:
            for a,b in zip(marks,marks[1:]):
                for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
            # final marker launches only when there is an existing segment pattern
            if len(marks)>2:
                for c in range(marks[-1]+1,len(row)): out[r][c]=3
